fixes.part: bronze tone (base band, cornice band, mullions) vs lift_drum
fixes.problem: In the Cycles canonical, the whole base band (~0.22 m), the whole cornice band and the mullion faces read as bright polished copper-orange. lift_drum (canonical r6, styles.jpg) and the concept (sheet-vs-lift-cable #2) are near-black blackened bronze, with polish only on thin edge beads and rivets. Side by side, the car will look like a different product from the drum it rides in.
fixes.target: Make the base and cornice bands dark blackened bronze (the same slot as the lift_drum body), with two 0.02-0.03 m polished beads at the top and bottom edge of each band. Keep the rivets polished. Mullions: dark body, with the polished bead only on the outer 0.01 m face.

fixes.problem: The two sheaves render as flat, blown-out white D-shaped discs with no rim, groove or hub. They are the brightest thing in the frame and read as paper or emissive cards, not machinery. The crossbar under them is a rough slab, and the 4 guide rods barely register.
fixes.target: Bronze (not emissive or white) sheaves, r 0.16-0.18 m and 0.05 m thick, with a polished grooved rim, a 0.06 m hub boss and a 4-6 spoke or pierced web. Set them on a turned crosshead beam ~0.9 m long with polished end caps. Make the rods 0.03-0.04 m dia polished and rising 0.5-0.6 m so they read against a dark well.

fixes.problem: At LOD0/1 the cabin is dark below the ceiling (sheet_34: an empty cage with a lit floor ring). At LOD2 it jumps to a fully opaque, fibre-textured glowing paper drum. That is a large brightness and texture pop at the ~30 m switch. The concept and ref-spiral-stair show the car as an amber lantern filled with light, with two small wall lanterns inside flanking the door at about 2.0 m.
fixes.target: Raise the sunburst ceiling emission ~2x. Move the two door lanterns (0.3 x 0.1 m at 2.0 m) inside the glass, as in the concept, which also removes the +0.13 m outside the well clearance. At LOD2/3, drop the core to emissive ~0.3 and use a smooth warm amber with no washi fibre texture, so LOD1 and LOD2 match in brightness.

fixes.part: LOD2/LOD3 dado ring and LOD3 hub
fixes.problem: The dado/rail ring has a visible notch or step on the front-left at LOD2 (all seeds) and at LOD3 (seeds 1-2) in sheet_34. In the stock front view, LOD2 shows black stubs at each end of the ring. The LOD3 crosshead is a square box, which reads as a chimney.
fixes.target: Close the ring arc cleanly to 360 degrees, or end it flush at the door jambs with no overlap. Make the LOD3 hub a 6-sided turned cylinder (r ~0.25, h 0.25). This stays within the 120-tri budget.

fixes.problem: Front-on in the Cycles canonical the glass is clear (r1/r2 fix landed). In the Cycles 3/4 sheet the panes are fully invisible, so the car reads as an open birdcage. The concept shows curved glass with vertical highlight streaks. The canonical also shows a crisp white rectangle and a dark-blue band through the front door leaves. These are probably key-light and HDRI reflections, but this is not verified.
fixes.target: Give the cabin glass a faint warm tint (transmission ~0.95/0.90/0.82) and roughness 0.03, so pane curvature catches light at grazing angles. Add 0.015 m polished glazing beads on each mullion. Verify the white rectangle with a key-light-off canonical. If it persists, it is still a door-leaf normal or material bug.

fixes.problem: The low dome rises only ~0.1 m and is nearly flat from eye height in the canonical. The concept dome rises ~0.33 m above the cornice (118->150 px at 96 px/m on the sheet scale bar), with ribs.
fixes.target: Low dome rise >= 0.25 m, with 8 polished ribs (0.03 m) that read in silhouette. Keep tall and onion as they are.

library_issues: bronze polish slot reads copper-orange rather than the gold-bronze of the concept's polished trims; the lift_drum trims look the same, so this is a library tone issue as much as a slot-assignment issue.
glass_clear has no tint or grazing-angle response, so the panes vanish entirely in 3/4 Cycles views.
the key fret behind the lower glass reads teal/cyan-green in the canonical, probably from env reflection on the polish slot. Worth checking the polish slot under the scene's lighting.
summary: It now reads as the concept's object: a round glass-and-bronze cabin with the right h/D (1.10 vs a measured 1.15), polished rivet bands, a lift_drum key-fret dado with handrail, a sunburst ceiling, a ringed lit floor, a crosshead with rods, and three clearly different seeds. It passes at 6.7. The remaining gaps are style and finish. The frame bronze is too bright and polished next to lift_drum's blackened bronze. The sheaves render as blown-out white cards. The cabin is dark inside at LOD0/1 and then pops to an opaque paper lantern at LOD2. There is a ring notch at LOD2/3 and a box hub at LOD3. Fixes 1-3 are the priority before final scene placement.
